forum.title: STLink porgrammer up and down like a sabbath lift
forum.best_answer_content:
​@KMill

100% failure would probably help more 😅.

Half-kidding, but let's give us a chance to help you! Could you at least share more about the device (board) you're connecting to?

Also, could you please copy and paste the debug console trace when it fails?

*(Tip: Two extra directives can be added to your `launch.json` file to get more details if needed.)*

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/6f0e8288-7615-419c-953c-834ba842428b.png)
forum.content_text:
I’m using VSC with the STM32 extensions.

When running debug sessions at leat 50% of the time I get this error message:

> Error in initializing ST-LINK device.

> Reason: USB communication error. Please reconnect the ST-LINK USB cable and try again.

> cube has exited with code 3

I have a good quality USB lead and I’m running on macOS on a Mac Mini M2

scraped_replies.html:
Well, 

It wasn’t the lead of the programmer.

It was my USB Hub. It died this morning completely.

Strangely, yesterday only the STLink was playing up - the mouse and USB Microscope were both fine, but this morning every port was dead.

New hub and everything is working well today.
scraped_replies.author: KMill

scraped_replies.html: Thank you for the idea, btw.  Nobody has invented a sabbath USB hub yet, it’s interesting how such thing can be used, and for which commandment  ;)
